name: Tabetha's Farm
summary: Deep in the murkiest reaches of the Quagmire lies Tabetha's Farm, an isolated homestead centered around a small wooden hut, a modest garden, and a private dock. Despite the treacherous marsh surroundings, this sanctuary serves as a hidden redoubt for the hermit mage Tabetha.

sections.title: A Hermit's Sanctuary
sections.body: Tucked away in the western wetlands of Dustwallow Marsh, Tabetha's Farm defies its unforgiving environment. Consisting of a weather-worn hut, small vegetable plots, and a dock for navigating the swamp's murky waterways, the homestead offers a quiet refuge far from the political rivalries of Theramore and Brackenwall Village. Here, the reclusive human sorceress Tabetha lives in near-total seclusion, pursuing esoteric studies of arcane and fel power without interference from Dalaran or local authorities.

sections.title: A Waypoint of Arcane Power
sections.body: Despite its remote location, the farm attracts practitioners of the magical arts from across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms. Mages seeking mastery over raw arcane surges and warlocks seeking aid to cleanse volatile artifacts like the Orb of Orahil are directed to Tabetha's doorstep.

faq.answer: The farm is home to the eccentric mage Tabetha, who keeps the small garden, dock, and homestead amidst the perilous swamp creatures of the Quagmire.

faq.q: Why do mages travel all the way to this farm?
faq.answer: Mage trainers across the world direct promising students to Tabetha to further their arcane knowledge. She possesses deep expertise regarding volatile mana surges, ancient relics, and primal powers that standard city academies rarely teach.
Warlocks seek out Tabetha's expertise in exorcism and elemental energies when working to purify and tame dangerous artifacts, most notably during the rituals required to cleanse the Orb of Orahil.

faq.q: Is Tabetha's Farm allied with the Horde or the Alliance?
faq.answer: Tabetha maintains a neutral stance, offering her wisdom to travelers regardless of their political allegiance. Her farm remains independent of both Jaina Proudmoore's Theramore and the Horde forces at Brackenwall Village.

angles.text: Your trainers in the capital cities hold Tabetha's esoteric knowledge in high esteem, sending adept spellcasters to her farm to investigate volatile mana surges and ancient relics of power.
Though she lives as a quiet swamp hermit, Tabetha is one of the few spellcasters capable of assisting you in cleansing the potent energies bound to the Orb of Orahil.
